disclaimer: This mapping records the technical status of controls in this repository. It is not a statement of compliance with any law, regulation or security standard. Legal and security review is required before operational deployment.

controls.requirement: Role-based access control enforced server-side on every endpoint
Organisation (tenant) isolation; identifiers from other tenants return 404
Restricted access classification for sensitive cases
Argon2id password hashing, lockout after repeated failures, login rate limiting
Short-lived access tokens bound to revocable server-side sessions; refresh rotation
Optional TOTP multi-factor authentication
controls.evidence: Enrolment and login enforcement implemented; no recovery codes or admin-enforced MFA policy; not covered by automated tests

controls.requirement: Integration with institutional identity providers (SAML/OIDC)
Content-based file validation; executables, macros, unsafe archives and malformed media rejected
Malware scanning of uploads
controls.evidence: ClamAV clamd adapter implemented; not exercised in this build environment; AEGIS_REQUIRE_MALWARE_SCAN enforces presence

controls.requirement: Uploaded content treated as untrusted data; instruction-like text recorded as an observation only
Security headers, CSP, CORS restrictions, correlation IDs
TLS termination and HSTS in production
controls.evidence: Deployment guide documents a TLS-terminating reverse proxy; not configured in development

controls.requirement: No secrets in responses, logs or reports; watermark keys represented by fingerprints
Managed secret store (e.g. Vault, cloud KMS)
controls.evidence: Environment-variable injection only; integration depends on host platform

controls.requirement: Encryption of stored evidence and database at rest
controls.evidence: S3 backend requests SSE (AES256); local filesystem and PostgreSQL rely on host disk encryption; MFA secrets encrypted at field level

controls.requirement: Locked dependencies and vulnerability scanning
controls.evidence: uv.lock and pnpm-lock.yaml committed; make security-check runs pip-audit and pnpm audit; results depend on scan date

controls.requirement: SHA-256 at acquisition, write-once content-addressed storage, versioned derivatives
Integrity re-verification with high-priority alert on mismatch
Legally certified chain of custody
controls.evidence: Technical records exist; legal certification requires a validated operational process and legal review

controls.requirement: Append-only, hash-chained audit trail with verification
External anchoring of the audit chain head
controls.evidence: /api/v1/audit/head exposes the head for anchoring; no automatic anchoring service

controls.requirement: Automated outcomes never trigger adverse action; human review decision required to finalise reports
Separation of duties (case creator cannot review; author cannot finalise; requester cannot approve own deletion)
Appeal and correction workflow
controls.evidence: test_appeal_workflow; report corrections create new versions

controls.requirement: Data minimisation: no demographic collection, no biometric identification, no speaker/face identification
controls.evidence: No such fields or methods exist; subgroup data only from evaluation datasets

controls.requirement: Retention policies, legal hold, two-person deletion with tombstones
Redaction producing derivative versions while preserving the original
External processing disabled by default; three-level authorisation (deployment, organisation, case)
Privacy impact assessment
India Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 compliance
controls.evidence: No compliance is claimed; requires legal review of the operational deployment

controls.requirement: EU AI Act obligations (if applicable to the deployer)
Admissibility of reports as evidence
Simulated, measured, published and vendor-reported results kept separate
Detectors cannot be marked validated without locally measured benchmark evidence
Strict-FPR operating points flagged as not estimable when sample size is insufficient
Validated AI-text detector for English and Indian languages
controls.evidence: No model weights are bundled; adapters exist and require locally supplied weights plus benchmark validation

controls.requirement: Independent third-party evaluation
Backups and tested restore
controls.evidence: Procedure in docs/operations/backup-and-recovery.md; restore test must be executed by the operator

controls.requirement: Load testing with documented results
controls.evidence: scripts/loadtest.py provided; results in docs/operations/performance.md are from the development container only

controls.requirement: Government security certification
controls.evidence: AEGIS holds no certification; none is claimed
